title: Deploy prepared systemd units for Oracle lane fleet (closes heartbeat-cgroup-kill gap)
description:
Systemd unit files are already written in this workspace's  directory and reviewed, but **not installed**. This issue requests the human/agent with  on  to deploy them via the existing helper script. Initial assignee is Oracle (the issue creator) to avoid an auto-block; reassign to Ops human/agent for the actual  step.

## Why this is needed

The 5-min bash keep-alive (BUY-30854) cannot keep lanes alive during 20-30 min heartbeat-cgroup-kill windows. Latest diagnostic on [BUY-31847](/BUY/issues/BUY-31847) showed throughput at 389k products/hr (2.6x the 150k target) but with 20-30 min heartbeat gaps leaving lanes dark.

Systemd  +  closes the gap to ~15 seconds.

## Deploy command

```bash
sudo bash /paperclip/instances/default/projects/177bc805-e3c8-4336-84cb-8e1e482d5a17/18221361-973a-493e-9e19-4c43b7a1c6eb/_default/scripts/deploy-systemd-units.sh
```

The script copies the 5 unit files to /etc/systemd/system/, runs systemctl daemon-reload, enables and starts each unit, and prints status.

## Units to deploy

1. paperclip-buy30331-sustained-loop.service
2. paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop.service
3. paperclip-buy30727-lane-supervisor.service (skipped when data/buy30727-supervisor.stopped exists per BUY-31452)
4. paperclip-loop-supervisor.service
5. paperclip-lane-keep-alive.service

## Pre-flight

- All 5 unit files exist in systemd/
- Existing paperclip units (kill-watcher, sigkill-trap) are already installed
- paperclip user has no sudo NOPASSWD; this requires an Ops human/agent with root

## Acceptance

- All 5 units show Active: active (running) after deploy
- systemctl show paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop | grep Restart shows Restart=always
- Simulated kill is recovered within 15-30 seconds
- Heartbeat log shows no DEAD ticks for 24 hours
- Hourly throughput remains >= 300k products/hr
